# A cinder of the trail: a glowing coal with four little flames (the tallest the hottest; unlit), 0.36 x 0.36 x 0.34 m.
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Coal --base-color 0.9020 0.2706 0.2235 --no-slot --emission 0.9020 0.2706 0.2235
material new Flame --base-color 1.0000 0.5373 0.2000 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.5373 0.2000
material new Tip --base-color 1.0000 0.6824 0.4392 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.6824 0.4392
add mesh cylinder --name Coal --vertices 6 --radius 0.18 --depth 0.05 --location 0 0 0.025
material assign Coal
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cone --name F0 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.09 --radius2 0 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 0.190
material assign Tip
add mesh cone --name F1 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.07 --radius2 0 --depth 0.2 --location 0.09 0.05 0.140
material assign Flame
add mesh cone --name F2 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.07 --radius2 0 --depth 0.22 --location -0.08 0.04 0.150
material assign Flame
add mesh cone --name F3 --vertices 5 --radius1 0.065 --radius2 0 --depth 0.17 --location 0.01 -0.09 0.125
material assign Flame
select Coal F0 F1 F2 F3
active Coal
join
select all
shade flat
export ember.glb
